6.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: {Key constraints: n=10,k=5 so ℓ-cohesive needs |S|≥2ℓ and some voter in S gets ≥ℓ reps. 6-voter group {1-3,8-10} is 3-cohesive on {x1,x2,x3} (requires some member ≥3 reps). 4-voter group {4-7} is 2-cohesive on {y4,y5,y6} (requires some member ≥2 reps). 

Disagreements center on whether |W∩{x}| can be 2 (with voter 1 or voters 8-10 supplying the 3rd rep via z1/y1) or must be 3; and whether 4 approvals for voter 1 is feasible (must simultaneously give y-group two approved members). 

Evidence shows 2x + z1 + 2y satisfies both large groups (voters 8-10 get 3; y-group gets 2) while voter 1 gets exactly 2; 3x + 2y satisfies both while voter 1 gets 3. Attempts at 4 for voter 1 (2x+y1+z3+1 other) leave y-group with at most 1 rep, violating EJR. 1 or 0 for voter 1 leaves the 6-voter group unsatisfied. Thus range exactly [2,3] (H). 

Preserve: exact cohesive sizes, possible W examples achieving 2 vs 3, and why 4 fails.}

- 3x + 2y: voters 8-10 get 3; voter 1 gets exactly 3.
- 2x + (y1 or z3) + 2y: voter 1 gets exactly 3; Gy satisfied; Gx covered by voter 1.
